en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, straight boulevard lined with uniform multi‑story buildings and pruned trees on both sides. A tram runs along tracks in the center of the street, with pedestrians and a few people standing along the sidewalks. The style suggests an early 20th‑century urban scene. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location as Boulevard Hamidié in Salonique (Thessaloniki).
